verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Tap to Pay on iPhone solution under a mobile-iOS build path that lets an iPhone act as the payment interface. It also markets turning compatible smartphones or tablets into Tap to Pay checkouts, which points to an official mobile in-app integration. The evidence never names an SDK, and Android is not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation (installation, API surface), explicit Android SDK evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed in-person payments into my own iOS or Android app with official mobile SDKs

citations.quote: With our Tap to Pay on iPhone solution you can accept contactless in-person payments using an iPhone as the payment interface, and process these payments on the Adyen payments platform.
Turn compatible smartphones or tablets into Tap to Pay checkouts. No extra hardware required.
